## Common WHERE Filters

### 分区过滤（必须）
```sql
-- 日期 + 小时
WHERE grass_date = date'${grass_date}'
  AND h = ${TODAY_HOUR}

-- 日期 + region 列表
WHERE grass_date = date'${grass_date}'
  AND grass_region in (${grass_region})

-- 单 region
WHERE grass_date = '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
  AND grass_region like 'ID'
```

### 业务过滤
```sql
-- Banner 入口过滤（最常见）
AND (get_json_object(banner.json_data, '$.entrance') in (5, 60))
OR (get_json_object(banner.json_data, '$.entrance') in (6, 59) AND if(app_ver regexp '\\.',regexp_replace(app_ver,'\\.',''),app_ver) >= '35800')

-- 排除特定 operation
AND operation != 15

-- Brand Ads space group
AND get_json_object(banner.dl_json_data,'$.space_group_id') like '6'
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### JOIN dim_entry_point_mapping_v2（entrance 映射）
```sql
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dim_entry_point_mapping_v2 AS t2
  ON t1.entrance = t2.entrance
-- 获取 t2.entry_point as scence
```

### JOIN on unique_id + region + date + entrance
```sql
LEFT JOIN ubta_tracking AS t2
  ON t1.unique_id = t2.unique_id
 AND t1.grass_date = t2.grass_date
 AND t1.entrance = t2.entrance
 AND t1.grass_region = t2.grass_region
-- 用于 ads tracking 与 UBTA 数据去重对比
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- 曝光计数
SUM(IF(operation = 1, 1, 0)) AS imp_cnt

-- 按 slotid 分组曝光
SUM(IF(operation = '1', 1, 0)) AS slot_imp_cnt
GROUP BY dt, country, slotid

-- unique_id 去重统计
COUNT(*) AS unique_id_dcnt
COUNT(DISTINCT unique_id) AS unique_id_distinct_cnt

-- 重复率
(SUM(IF(unique_id IS NOT NULL, num, 0)) - SUM(IF(unique_id IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)))
  / SUM(IF(unique_id IS NOT NULL, num, 0)) AS unique_id_dup_rate

-- 按 entrance + region + date 分组统计
GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date, entrance, scence
GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date, entrance, page_type, page_section, target_type, operation, platform
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: DWD ETL -- 解析 banner JSON 生成结构化表
```sql
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE dwd_display_ads_tracking_hi__reg_s0_live
PARTITION (grass_region, grass_date, h)
SELECT
    userid AS user_id
    ,sessionid AS session_id
    ,deviceid AS device_id
    ,client_ip
    ,CAST(platform AS bigint) AS platform
    ,timestamp, token
    ,`from` AS source
    ,CAST(get_json_object(banner.json_data,'$.shop_id') AS bigint) AS shop_id
    ,CASE WHEN banner.source = 2 THEN banner.bannerid ELSE NULL END AS ads_id
    ,CASE WHEN banner.source = 2 THEN NULL ELSE banner.bannerid END AS banner_id
    ,CAST(get_json_object(banner.json_data,'$.location') AS bigint) AS organic_location
    ,banner.source AS banner_source
    ,banner.json_data AS banner_json_data
    ,json_data AS tracking_json_data
    ,get_json_object(banner.json_data,'$.request_id') AS request_id
    ,fe_ab_sign
    ,named_struct('frauds', internal_label.frauds, 'sessionid', internal_label.sessionid) AS internal_label
    ,get_json_object(banner.json_data, '$.entrance') AS ads_entrance
    ,placement AS tracking_placement
    ,named_struct('banner_id', banner.bannerid, 'source', banner.source,
      'campaign_unit_id', banner.campaign_unitid, 'slot_id', banner.slotid,
      'json_data', banner.json_data, 'image_hash', banner.image_hash,
      'target_url', banner.target_url, 'dl_json_data', banner.dl_json_data) AS banner
    ,operation
    ,get_json_object(banner.json_data, '$.pricing_type') AS pricing_type
    ,CASE WHEN operation = 1 THEN 'IMPRESSION' WHEN operation = 2 THEN 'CLICK'
          WHEN operation = 3 THEN 'VIEW' WHEN operation = 4 THEN 'ADD_TO_CART'
          WHEN operation = 5 THEN 'PLACE_ORDER' WHEN operation = 1001 THEN 'SHOP_IMPRESSION'
          WHEN operation = 1002 THEN 'SHOP_CLICK' WHEN operation = 6 THEN 'CLOSE_BANNER'
          WHEN operation = 7 THEN 'REPORT_DISLIKE' WHEN operation = 8 THEN 'REPORT_INAPPROPRIATE'
          WHEN operation = 9 THEN 'REPORT_IRRELEVANT' WHEN operation = 10 THEN 'REPORT_IMPRESSION'
     END AS operation_desc
    ,CASE WHEN platform = 1 THEN 'IOS_WEB' WHEN platform = 2 THEN 'IOS_APP'
          WHEN platform = 3 THEN 'ANDROID_WEB' WHEN platform = 4 THEN 'ANDROID_APP'
          WHEN platform = 5 THEN 'PC_MALL' WHEN platform = 6 THEN 'IOS_LITE'
          WHEN platform = 7 THEN 'ANDROID_LITE' WHEN platform = 8 THEN 'PLATFORM_RESERVED'
          WHEN platform = 9 THEN 'ANDROID_APP_LITE' WHEN platform = 99 THEN 'XIAPI'
          WHEN platform = 128 THEN 'OTHERS' END AS platform_desc
    ,app_ver, rn_ver, view_session_id, sub_entrance
    ,get_json_object(banner.json_data,'$.ab_sign') AS ab_sign
    ,grass_region, grass_date, h
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_display_ads_tracking_hi__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = '${TODAY_DATE}' AND h = ${TODAY_HOUR}
```

### Snippet 2: Brand Ads 曝光监控 -- 按 slot 统计曝光
```sql
WITH base AS (
    SELECT grass_date AS dt
        ,userid, sessionid
        ,grass_region AS country
        ,operation, platform
        ,banner.bannerid, banner.slotid
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_display_ads_tracking_hi__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
      AND grass_region like 'ID'
      AND get_json_object(banner.dl_json_data,'$.space_group_id') like '6'
),
kafka AS (
    SELECT dt, country, slotid,
           SUM(IF(operation='1',1,0)) AS slot_imp_cnt
    FROM base
    GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT kafka.slotid, kafka.slot_imp_cnt, kafka.dt, kafka.country
FROM kafka
```

### Snippet 3: TMS 数据去重 -- Banner tracking 唯一 ID 统计
```sql
SELECT
    grass_region, grass_date,
    CAST(get_json_object(banner.json_data,'$.entrance') AS bigint) AS entrance,
    banner.unique_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_display_ads_tracking_hi__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = date'${grass_date}'
  AND grass_region IN (${grass_region})
  AND (
      (get_json_object(banner.json_data, '$.entrance') IN (5, 60))
      OR (get_json_object(banner.json_data, '$.entrance') IN (6, 59)
          AND IF(app_ver regexp '\\.',regexp_replace(app_ver,'\\.',''),app_ver) >= '35800')
  )
GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date,
    CAST(get_json_object(banner.json_data,'$.entrance') AS bigint),
    banner.unique_id
```

### Snippet 5: Banner detail diff -- 详细字段对比
```sql
SELECT
    userid AS user_id, sessionid AS session_id,
    deviceid AS device_id, client_ip,
    page_type, COALESCE(page_section,'') AS page_section,
    COALESCE(target_type,'') AS target_type,
    CAST(platform AS bigint) AS platform,
    CAST(get_json_object(banner.json_data, '$.entrance') AS bigint) AS entrance,
    CAST(get_json_object(banner.json_data,'$.shop_id') AS bigint) AS shop_id,
    CAST(get_json_object(banner.json_data,'$.ads_id') AS bigint) AS ads_id,
    banner.bannerid, banner.source AS banner_source,
    banner.json_data AS banner_json_data,
    json_data AS tracking_json_data,
    operation,
    get_json_object(banner.json_data, '$.pricing_type') AS pricing_type,
    banner.slotid AS banner_slotid,
    banner.unique_id AS unique_id,
    banner.campaign_unitid AS banner_campaign_unitid,
    banner.image_hash AS banner_image_hash,
    banner.target_url AS banner_target_url,
    banner.card_location AS banner_card_location,
    banner.banner_cnt AS banner_banner_cnt,
    banner.landing_url_type AS banner_landing_url_type,
    banner.landing_page_url AS banner_landing_page_url,
    banner.landing_page_url AS banner_location,
    grass_region,
    date'${grass_date}' AS grass_date,
    IF(app_ver regexp '\\.',regexp_replace(app_ver,'\\.',''),app_ver) AS app_version,
    CASE WHEN rn_ver regexp '\\.'
         THEN CAST(CONCAT(LPAD(SPLIT(rn_ver, '\\.')[0],3,'0'),
                         LPAD(SPLIT(rn_ver, '\\.')[1],3,'0'),
                         LPAD(SPLIT(rn_ver, '\\.')[2],3,'0')) AS bigint)
         ELSE rn_ver END AS rn_version,
    dre_ver
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_display_ads_tracking_hi__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = date'${grass_date}'
  AND grass_region IN (${grass_region})
```
